name: Shiin -reboot-
source: Remake of Shiin to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the establishment of [url=/p7237]EXPERIENCE[/url]. It was funded using a [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/876315/view]crowdfunding campaign[/url] that reached 495% of the initial ten million yens goal.
translation: 为纪念[url=/p7237]EXPERIENCE[/url]成立20周年而翻拍的《Shiin》。它是通过 [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/876315/view]众筹活动[/url] 筹集资金，达到了最初1000万日元目标的495%。
